name: go9_liberty_planes
hypothesis: Adding 6 liberty planes (KataGo-style input features) improves training efficiency. KataGo found 1.55x improvement from input features. Liberty planes directly encode group health (atari, 2-lib, 3+lib) which the network otherwise must learn from raw stone patterns.
success_criteria: Compare with go9_fresh_correct at same iteration count. Should show lower loss and/or higher vsRandom at same training point. Kill if loss plateaus for 100 iters.
notes: 23 input planes (17 base + 6 liberty). New architecture - cannot warm-start from existing models. Uses go9_ext game variant. Requires C++ engine update for liberty planes (TODO if not done).
